flags.summary: Rep characterised the prospect's local doctors and physiotherapists as financially motivated to keep him returning, in order to displace a competing medical option for an undiagnosed multi-year back complaint.
evidence: they never actually taught him how to do the exercise and how to make sure that it doesn't come back anymore, because they want you to keep coming back because that's where they make their money from.
when it comes to those companies, usually it just comes down to that they, of course, want to help you, but eventually you're going to have to go back to get it fixed again.
if I had to spend 6K, I wouldn't spend it on an online course. I would spend it on, like, the doctor or this physiotherapist who is, like, very, like, well-known here in the city where I live

flags.summary: Prospect disclosed daily undiagnosed back pain of 4 to 6 out of 10 built up over years, and was moved toward loaded kettlebell training with no clinician clearance sought and no suggestion he have it assessed.
evidence: My back pain, so my back pain, it depends on the day. Sometimes it's like 6, sometimes it's 4, it varies. I would say it's between 4 and 6, depending on the day.
if you have a huge back pain, you need to go to the doctor or take some medication, which I don't want to do.
kettlebells, they force our body to basically work as an entire unit. So we don't train our chest by itself, our shoulders by itself. No, we train everything from top to bottom

flags.summary: Rep told a prospect with undiagnosed chronic back pain that the programme would reduce it to zero, an unqualified therapeutic claim about a condition no clinician had assessed.
evidence: as you do those 5 to 15 minute daily protocols for it that are targeted towards that area if you focus on that eventually the 4 and 6 will get lower and lower but then eventually we'll be at 0 and then it will get better
So as you're doing those workouts it's already going to correct your posture for you but then also over time it will get rid of the back pain
based on what I'm hearing it sounds like we can definitely help you out get to the goals of where you do get rid of that back pain

flags.summary: In the consequence frame, the rep used the prospect potentially needing to see a doctor or take medication as the negative outcome to be avoided, reinforcing his stated resistance to seeking medical care.
evidence: you mentioned medication maybe go to the doctor like you mentioned that could potentially happen if the back pain keeps getting worse do you feel like that is something that could happen
yeah that could happen if if my back pain is worse I might have to go to the doctor which I don't want
it doesn't sound like you would want or would be able to. To actually settle for the life where you maybe have to go on medications, have to go to the doctor, it is worse.

flags.summary: Prospect disclosed SIBO with gluten and lactose triggers; the rep did not acknowledge it and subsequently presented intermittent fasting, full-day fasts and a calorie-counting phase without reference to the condition.
evidence: I have this issue I don't know the name in English is SIBO like it's just like if I it's said like gluten or if I eat lactose I feel like super full
So we do want to look into that, because when we combine not eating the whole day when we're awake, with making sure we eat whole foods, carbs, veggies, protein
it could either be 14 hours, 10 hours window, Trevor himself does a lot of full-day fests as well
